message.content:
This image shows a **web UI interface** (likely a dashboard or admin panel) displaying program management cards with a comparison between two states. Here's the detailed breakdown:

## Overall Layout
- Two horizontal card rows stacked vertically
- Dark gray/black background between them
- Handwritten annotations/arrows indicating a transformation

---

## Top Card (Original State)
**Background:** White/light gray rounded rectangle

**Left Section - Program Title:**
- **Icon:** Briefcase/document icon (📋)
- **Text:** "Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — DPD Kalimantan Barat"
- **Badge:** Gray pill-shaped tag showing "30 program"

**Right Section - Action Buttons:**
1. **"Upload PDF" button** - White background, black text, upload icon (↑) on left
2. **"Tambah Program" button** - Blue/purple gradient background, white text, plus icon (+) on left

---

## Middle Annotation Area
- Text: "**Menjadi**" (Indonesian for "Becomes")
- Arrow pointing down to second card
- Oval shape containing: "**Lihat dok**" (abbreviation for "Lihat dokumen" / "View document")

---

## Bottom Card (Modified State)
**Background:** White/light gray rounded rectangle

**Left Section - Modified Title:**
- **Icon:** Briefcase icon (📋)
- **Text:** "Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — [BLACK RECTANGLE] — DPD Kalimantan Barat"
  - *Note: There's a black rectangular redaction/placeholder between the em-dashes*
- **New Element:** A document/file icon inserted between the title parts (appears to be a clickable attachment or document preview icon)

**Right Section - Action Buttons:**
- Identical to top card:
  1. **"Upload PDF" button** (white, with upload icon)
  2. **"Tambah Program" button** (blue gradient, with plus icon)

---

## Design Elements Summary
- **Typography:** Sans-serif font, bold for titles, regular for buttons
- **Color scheme:** White cards, blue accent (#4F46E5 or similar), gray badges
- **Icons:** Line-style icons (briefcase, upload arrow, plus sign)
- **Spacing:** Generous padding inside cards, aligned button groups to the right
- **Visual hierarchy:** Title left-aligned, actions right-aligned, badge inline with title

The image appears to demonstrate a **UI state change** where a document attachment is added to the program card, with the annotation suggesting this allows users to "view documents" (Lihat dok).
